unitTitle: Greet, be polite, spell your name
title: Dialogues
subtitle: Unit 2: Greet, be polite, spell your name

steps.title: On the phone: an email address
steps.body: Marc calls Sam. They are friends, so they use tu.

examples.en: Marc: Hello, Sam? It is Marc.
Sam: Hi, Marc! How are you?

examples.fr: Oui, ça va. Tu as un courriel ?
examples.en: Marc: Yes, fine. Do you have an email?

examples.fr: Oui. Mon courriel est sam, arobase, exemple, point c-a.
examples.en: Sam: Yes. My email is sam, at, example, dot c-a.
Marc: Sorry? Say it again, please.
Sam: Yes. More slowly. S-A-M, at...
Marc: Okay. Thank you very much!

steps.title: At the library desk
steps.body: Samira gets a library card. The librarian uses vous.

examples.fr: Bonjour, madame. Votre nom, s'il vous plaît ?
examples.en: Employée: Hello, madam. Your name, please?
Samira: Haddad. It is spelled H-A-D-D-A-D.
Employée: Thank you. How old are you?

examples.fr: Pardon ? Plus lentement, s'il vous plaît.
Votre numéro de cellulaire, s'il vous plaît.
examples.en: Employée: Your cell phone number, please.

examples.fr: Ah, d'accord ! C'est le six, un, trois, cinq, cinq, cinq, zéro, un, quatre, deux.

steps.prompt: Why does Marc ask Sam to repeat?
options: He did not catch the email

steps.prompt: What does the librarian want at the end?
What does Sam say after Marc thanks him?
